criteria.then: The gate fails with a diagnostic

stories.assumptions: Review checks meaning and pre-code chronology

stories.story: As the project owner, I want observable heartbeats for long-running CI workloads, so that slow work is distinguishable from missing progress without killing healthy tests.

criteria.then: Report elapsed time and age of last observed output, or explicitly report no output yet.
Warn about missing output without declaring a hang or terminating the subprocess.
Preserve its exit result and actual output; never convert a failure into success.

criteria.given: The mandatory CI runs its long asset, test and packaging workloads
criteria.then: Use the heartbeat wrapper without removing existing hard deadlines, coverage or security checks.

stories.scope: Long subprocesses in the reusable CI workflow; progress signals are subprocess output and liveness, not proof of internal progress.
stories.constraints: No new paid service or external dependency; no silent-time termination; retain existing blocking gates and job deadlines.
stories.assumptions: Default heartbeat 30 seconds, silence warning 120 seconds; tune from observed logs.
stories.dependencies: Python standard library; existing GitHub Actions jobs; PR #26 story protocol
stories.impact: CI diagnostics only; no runtime or release version change.

stories.source: Owner request 2026-11-26: monitor tests, consolidate branches and close superseded PRs without conflicts.
stories.story: As the owner, I want all retained fixes reconciled against one tested development revision so obsolete PRs can close without losing changes.

criteria.given: The verified asset changes from PR #24 overlap CI heartbeat
criteria.then: The explicit GLB validation and test fixtures, stable sorting locale and coverage source are preserved alongside heartbeat.
The story gate, production build, security and blocking SonarCloud all execute without lowering thresholds.

stories.scope: Consolidate PR #24 with heartbeat in PR #27; close superseded PRs after verifying retained changes; keep release version separate.
stories.constraints: No production publication from this quality PR; no bypass or loss of coverage, tests or canonical source.
stories.assumptions: PR #26 is already merged; exact integrated revision needs fresh gates.
stories.dependencies: PR #24 verifier and fixtures; PR #27 heartbeat; merged #26 RTM.
stories.impact: CI and office validation; no version bump.

stories.source: Owner request 2026-11-26: اصلحه واعده; failed CI 45768123240 draft validation; Owner 2026-11-26 explicitly requests 1.6.17 as-is, deferring unfinished graphics improvements to the following release.
stories.story: As the owner, I want an isolated native CLI regression test for verified release publication, so that the release gate reliably catches real failures instead of mock artifacts.

criteria.given: A local draft with exact fixture assets
criteria.when: The publication script queries its metadata and validates downloaded bytes
criteria.then: The draft is accepted only with correct tag, draft state, sizes and hashes.
Only verification retries; creation and publication occur once.

criteria.given: A malformed draft or changed downloaded bytes
criteria.then: No publish command occurs and the script fails.

stories.scope: Release 1.6.17 from the integrated development baseline including verified KTX2 and CI heartbeat; exclude PR #30, #31, #32 and subsequent graphics experiments. Preserve isolated PowerShell publication regression tests.
stories.constraints: Keep blocking automated CI, security, SonarCloud and exact candidate provenance. Owner explicitly defers remaining physical GPU, visual contact and installed-device validation; do not claim these passed. No unreviewed graphics assets in default runtime.
stories.assumptions: Prior failure is consistent with mock argument/exit handling; native fixture will establish actual behavior.
stories.dependencies: PR #26 and #27 integrated; release verification and publication tests; current development and reconciled PR gates.
stories.impact: Release tooling only; version remains candidate until approved.

tests.id: retries stale public metadata without recreating or republishing the release
rejects an invalid draft without publishing it
rejects tampered downloaded bytes without publishing them

stories.story: As a maintainer, I want multilingual user stories decoded consistently in Windows and Linux tests so that valid Arabic requirements do not break release verification.

criteria.then: The test reads valid JSON using explicit UTF-8 rather than the host code page

criteria.given: Verified meeting and walking fixes and a review-only bake candidate
criteria.then: All existing CI, SonarCloud and security gates run against the exact integrated revision

stories.scope: Correct the Windows test decoding bug and integrate PR #30, #31 and #32 after v1.6.17 publication.
stories.constraints: Keep release-version 1.6.17 until next release is accepted. Preserve all previous stories, tests, gates and original default PBR assets.

stories.impact: Regression test portability and integration; no new public release.
